indicator.name: Cboe NASDAQ-100 Volatility Index (VXN)
indicator.description: The options-implied expected 30-day volatility of the NASDAQ-100, the NASDAQ counterpart of the VIX.
indicator.methodology: Daily closes of the Cboe NASDAQ-100 Volatility Index. The score is the historical percentile of the current level over the configured window.
indicator.limitations: Elevated VIX is not proof that equities are cheap. VIX measures implied volatility and can remain elevated during prolonged drawdowns. It is a supplementary sentiment and risk indicator.
